config_file.description: Name of the shell config file in /etc/default/, without path or extension

daemon_opts.description: Additional options passed to the daemon on invocation

doodle_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories where doodle looks for data (shell variable: DOODLE_PATH)

ownership_user.description: User owner of the database directory (used in chown)

ownership_group.description: Group owner of the database directory (used in chown)

doodle_dbpath.description: Path to the doodle database file (used in chmod and chown)
